title: Project Arsenal Experiment Protocol
description: Machine-checkable experiment protocol record for the Arsenal research program. The protocol enforces the ARS-000 contract defined in docs/arsenal-experiment-contract.md. Composite score fields and runtime-authority tokens (filesystem.write, network.write, git.write, production.mutate, cloud.remote) are refused. remote_credentials_used must be false. Negative knowledge is first-class; promotion decisions are recorded, not made, by Arsenal.

schema.description: Schema identity for this protocol record.

experiment_id.description: Stable experiment identifier matching the registry entry.

title.description: Specific title describing the claim under test.

research_program.description: Path or reference to the owning research program artifact.

source_observation.description: Observation or registry entry that motivated the experiment.

hypothesis.description: Candidate claim under test, including scope and assumptions.

falsifier.description: Observable outcome that would falsify the hypothesis.

system_under_test.description: Component, method, prompt, workflow, or surface being measured.

candidate_conditions.description: Treatment condition; differences from baseline must be explicit.

perturbations.description: Intentional variations applied to test robustness.

model_identity.description: Model identity and version when known.

harness_identity.description: Harness or runner identity and version.

primary_metrics.description: Metrics that decide the hypothesis. No composite scores.

repetition_policy.description: Number of repetitions, sampling strategy, and rationale.

seed_policy_if_relevant.description: Seed or randomization policy if applicable.

protocol_version.description: Semantic version of this protocol. New versions are new artifacts.

protocol_frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which this version was frozen. Null until frozen.

derived_evidence_locations.description: Paths to derived evidence artifacts and reproduction commands.

result.description: Final qualitative result. Null while running or unassessed.

limitations.description: Known limitations bounding the claim scope.

counterevidence.description: Observations that contradict or weaken the hypothesis.

negative_findings.description: Negative results produced by the experiment.

possible_promotion_targets.description: Products, contracts, or capabilities that could be affected if promoted. Arsenal does not promote.

qualification_status.description: Qualification status of the experiment's claim.

promotion_status.description: Promotion status. promoted is recorded only from an external decision.

remote_credentials_used.description: Arsenal protocols must not use remote credentials.

digest.description: Optional SHA-256 digest of the identified artifact.
